Description: Sets the server owner's RuneScape: Dragonwilds EOS Player ID. This can be found in-game at the bottom of the Settings Menu
Sets the 'CREATED BY' name for the server shown in the client server list. Maximum 64 characters
Sets the name of the default world that is created on start. This is shown as the server name in the client server list and is used for search. Case-sensitive. Maximum 64 characters
Sets the admin password, allowing access to the Server Management tab in-game. Default is a secure random password
Sets the password required to join the server. Empty = no password

Sets the maximum number of players AMP reports and tracks for the server. The game itself allows 6; raising this only has an effect in-game if a mod lifts the game's player cap. If the PlayerCapTen UE4SS mod is installed, this value is also written to its PlayerCap in ue4ss/Mods/PlayerCapTen/Scripts/main.lua when the server is updated (run Update after changing it). Players joining must use the same PlayerCap value in their own copy of the mod

Extra arguments added to the end of the server command line, separated by spaces (for example -TaskGraphThreads=4). Leave empty for none. Wrong arguments can stop the server from starting; clear this field if it no longer starts

Sets the action to take when the server is updated. If installing, the [UE4SS-RE experimental build](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental) set in UE4SS Build Version is extracted into RSDragonwilds/Binaries/Win64/ue4ss, and a version.dll proxy is installed in place of the client-only dwmapi.dll (the dedicated server does not load dwmapi.dll). ue4ss/UE4SS.dll is replaced on every update so the chosen build is used; ue4ss/UE4SS-settings.ini and the ue4ss/Mods folder are not overwritten. "Remove UE4SS files and mods" deletes the whole ue4ss folder, mods included. CurseForge mods install into RSDragonwilds/Binaries/Win64/ue4ss/Mods

Sets the Proton GE [release version](https://github.com/GloriousEggroll/proton-ge-custom/releases) to install. Empty = latest. Default GE-Proton10-34: GE-Proton 11 has no esync/fsync, so the server falls back to slow server-side synchronisation. Changing it and running Update recreates the Proton prefix; saves and DedicatedServer.ini are in the game folder and are kept

Sets the [UE4SS-RE experimental build](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases/tag/experimental) to install. Default v3.0.1-1135-gf6d5f942 (f6d5f942, 14 Sep 2026), which C++ mods such as NearlyEnoughItems and QuestList need. v3.0.1-944-g0196ef29 is the older build CurseForge installs. Changing it and running Update replaces only ue4ss/UE4SS.dll; UE4SS-settings.ini and the Mods folder are kept

Written to [EngineVersionOverride] MajorVersion in ue4ss/UE4SS-settings.ini on update. UE4SS cannot detect the engine version of the RuneScape: Dragonwilds server by itself and stops with "PS scan timed out" without it. The server currently runs Unreal Engine 5.6
Written to [EngineVersionOverride] MinorVersion in ue4ss/UE4SS-settings.ini on update. The server currently runs Unreal Engine 5.6

Sets HookAActorTick and HookGameViewportClientTick in ue4ss/UE4SS-settings.ini on update. Disabled by default for server performance. HookEngineTick is always kept enabled and ExecuteInGameThread uses EngineTick: UE4SS learns the game thread from the first engine tick, and mods that call LoadAsset earlier fail with "GetGameThreadId called too early". Only enable if a mod specifically needs actor or viewport tick hooks
